## Why
Cart art the slot way: a 2600 cartridge card (silver label, picture label and Activision shapes) and real labels.

## Scope
- [ ] Retro bitmap 2600 card.
- [ ] `tools/fetch-labels.py`: system `A2600`, dat `Atari - 2600` (libretro-database no-intro), ScreenScraper id **26** (Skyscraper `platforms_idmap.csv` at c253bfe, row `atari2600,26,28,22`); label first, box fallback like SMS.
